title: 휴대폰 한글 자판: 천지인과 두벌식으로 쓰기
objective: You can type simple Korean words on both keyboards and read them aloud.
summary: Type Korean on a phone with the Cheonjiin and 2-set (Dubeolsik) keyboards.

task.title: Type and read Korean
task.line: Use the key rules on page 1 to build letters and words, then read each answer aloud.

words.exampleMeaning: Yes, I'm on my way now.

letters.as: Cheonjiin: dot right of the line makes ㅏ; dot left makes ㅓ.
Cheonjiin: dot above the line makes ㅗ; dot below makes ㅜ.
Cheonjiin: ㅓ (· + ㅣ) plus another ㅣ makes ㅔ.

letters.letter: Shift + ㄱ ㄷ ㅂ ㅅ ㅈ → ㄲ ㄸ ㅃ ㅆ ㅉ
letters.as: Dubeolsik: consonants on the left, vowels on the right; Shift makes double consonants.

exercises: Cheonjiin: which syllable do these taps make? ① ㄴ + ㅡ + · ② ㅅ + · + ㅣ ③ ㄱ + · + ㅡ
Dubeolsik: do you need the Shift key? Write Yes or No. ① ㅆ ② ㅎ ③ ㅃ
Dubeolsik: write the keys in the order you type them. ① 바다 ② 우산
Word list typing: write the keys in the order you type them. ① 네 on Cheonjiin ② 지금 on Dubeolsik ③ 친구 on Dubeolsik
answers: ① 누 ② 서 ③ 고
